notes.title: Final Sale & Retirement Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

thank you so much for all the kind support you've shown towards me and my game, I truly appreciate it. The game will retire from the Steam store November 1, 2019.
As a final thank you, I have decided to put the game on sale -90%.
The sale starts October 17, 2019 and ends October 31, 2019. 

Thank you, I love you all <3

~LaruaGames

notes.title: Retirement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

PolyKat is a little indie game that I made in my free time.
The game has been available on Steam for quite some time now and while I think it's a neat little game with colorful characters, I have to admit that I can't develop and maintain the game forever. So I have decided that I want to retire the game from Steam.
For everyone who bought the game, I am very grateful that you decided to support me and my little game. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart! 
I still don't have a specific date on when this will happen but I will post an announcement for you soon. Don't worry if you have bought the game, you can still play it as long as you meet the hardware requirements!

~LaruaGames

notes.title: Controller Update!
notes.notes:
PolyKat now supports a [b]controller[/b] on all platforms!
To find out more you can head to the options and there will be a new panel that shows button actions.
I've also updated how the slingshot moves when you're idle or moving your polykat. 
It should now be more comfortable to use than previously.
There was also a minor camera shake bug that I've patched.
Hopefully you will enjoy the updates!
